text: Jay Asher's Thirteen Reasons Why drew objections from parents of the Westwood (NJ) Regional Schools, who argued it could do "irrevocable harm" and should be pulled from the school. In Colorado, a school district official ordered the book temporarily removed from school-library checkout, citing recent events and media attention on the Netflix adaptation.
meta_description: Thirteen Reasons Why by Jay Asher: parents in Westwood, NJ sought its removal, and a Colorado district official temporarily removed it from checkout.
